baseline.actual: Release run 35412318983 failed at API image build because Vite helper sources were absent.

criteria.conditions: Repository-root BuildKit context; exact API, worker and SPA Dockerfiles; immutable base digests.
criteria.evidence_method: docker buildx build for all three workflow Dockerfiles plus image inspection and runtime smoke checks.
criteria.target: All three OCI image builds complete and contain the required runtime artifacts without build-only helper leakage.
criteria.validity_notes: Exercises the same Dockerfiles and root context used by the release workflow.

criteria.conditions: Trivy 0.65.0/action-equivalent vuln scanner; os,library; HIGH,CRITICAL; ignore-unfixed=false; exit-code=1.
criteria.evidence_method: Scan exact OCI archives locally, then require the three hosted workflow scan steps to pass.
criteria.target: API, worker and SPA exact candidate archives each produce exit 0 with zero HIGH/CRITICAL findings under the unchanged policy.
criteria.validity_notes: Scanner database is time-varying; hosted scan on the published candidate is final authority.

baseline.actual: Images run non-root but copy the full development workspace and vulnerable build tools.

criteria.conditions: Non-root runtime, production dependency closure, representative isolated configuration.
criteria.evidence_method: Image metadata inspection, container smoke tests and relevant production runtime/integration checks.
criteria.source: Image runtime contracts and Docker HEALTHCHECK/CMD
criteria.target: API and worker import/boot from production-only deploys; API and SPA health paths respond; all final images run as non-root and omit package-manager/build-tool payloads.
criteria.validity_notes: Boot/import checks must exercise the final images, not only the builder filesystem.

baseline.actual: CI 35410683318 passed 17/17 on the pre-image-fix SHA; becomes stale after source changes.

criteria.evidence_method: Run focused tests first, then the repository's relevant build/typecheck/lint and release validation commands; final authority is CI 17/17.
criteria.target: Focused container contracts, monorepo build/typecheck/lint and applicable release assurance tests pass without lowering thresholds.
criteria.validity_notes: Prior green CI is supporting only and cannot certify the changed candidate.

baseline.actual: No final image-remediation commit exists yet.

criteria.conditions: Push event on main, exact final commit SHA.
criteria.evidence_method: GitHub Actions API receipts bound to the exact SHA.
criteria.target: All 17 CI jobs pass on the final source commit.
criteria.validity_notes: A run for an ancestor does not satisfy this criterion.

baseline.actual: Release 35412318983 failed at API build; downstream steps were skipped.

criteria.conditions: Automatic workflow_run chain after successful push CI on main.
criteria.evidence_method: GitHub Actions release run and downloadable artifacts bound to the final SHA.
criteria.target: Release workflow completes builds, scans, quarantine publication, three attestations and verification, digest manifest, blocking gate, evidence package and final artifact upload.
criteria.validity_notes: Manual or local substitution cannot replace the workflow_run chain.

baseline.actual: Current diff touches no visual source, but final candidate CI is pending.

criteria.evidence_method: Diff inspection plus exact candidate visual CI job result.
criteria.target: No UI, design-system, copy, asset or rendered-output source changes; existing visual CI remains green.
criteria.validity_notes: If visual source changes, this criterion must be revised and rendered QA becomes mandatory.
